title: THE WELCOME PACK IS A CENTRED CARD
why: The critic scored the Welcome pack 2 of 5: a full-screen slab with seven rows hugging the left and the buttons 1600px apart. The style guide says a modal is a centred card at most 960 wide. It now takes the Terms frame, fitted to its content, with the list and footer 880 wide.
now: The welcome pack is a centred card.

edits.replacement: var CARDFIT={termsmodal:600,gamblemodal:620,barmodal:640,partymodal:760,welcomemodal:840};   // v28.xx (cw-welcomecard): the welcome pack is a fitted card too
